title: Grasshopper Cocktail
description: This retro grasshopper drink is like an after-dinner mint in a glass. Enjoy this delicious chocolatey cocktail classic with, or instead of, dessert.
ingredients: 0.75 fluid ounce white creme de cacao

steps.text: Combine crème de menthe, crème de cacao, cream, and ice in a cocktail shaker. Cover and shake until chilled. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

video.description: Looking for a sweet and refreshing drink to enjoy after dinner? Look no further than the Grasshopper Cocktail in this video. This delicious cocktail combines creme de menthe and white creme de cacao to create a chocolatey mint flavor that's perfect for dessert. To make the drink, simply combine the ingredients in a cocktail shaker with ice, shake, and strain into a chilled glass. For a blended version, blend the ingredients in a blender with ice until smooth. This easy-to-make cocktail is a crowd-pleaser and is sure to satisfy your sweet tooth.
